## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case
What problem does this feature address? What architectural pattern or workflow does it enable?

Examples:
- Support for new AWS service (e.g., EventBridge, Step Functions)
- Support for a new cloud provider (e.g. Azure, GCP)
- New component type (e.g., Saga, Process Manager)
- Enhanced adapter functionality
- New ReScript binding

## Proposed API/Usage
How would you like this feature to work? Include example code if possible.

```rescript
// Example usage of the proposed feature
```

## Current Workaround
How are you currently handling this use case (if at all)?

## Alternatives Considered
What alternative solutions, patterns, or approaches have you considered?

## Impact
- [ ] Affects core framework
- [ ] Affects AWS adapters
- [ ] Affects ReScript bindings
- [ ] Breaking change to existing API
- [ ] New component/module (additive)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Developer experience improvement

## Would you be willing to contribute this feature?
- [ ] Yes, I can submit a PR
- [ ] No, but I can help with testing
- [ ] No, just suggesting
